rationale: The Latin anchors *bulga* (leather bag/sack), *follis* (bellows/bag), *siliqua* (pod/husk), and *uter* (wineskin/leather bag) all point to a flexible container or pouch, directly matching bag.n.01 ("a flexible container with a single opening"). The Old English BELG referred to a bag, bellows, or pod-like container, which is the core literal sense of bag.n.01.
